title: ochna obtusata subsp. pumila
intro: Ochna obtusata subsp. pumila, commonly known as the dwarf ironplow, is a plant species belonging to the family Ochnaceae. The leaves and roots of Ochna obtusata subsp. pumila have been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The plant is believed to have health benefits, including its potential to lower blood sugar levels and act as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of Ochna obtusata subsp. pumila include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
